title: Match report
instruction: Ask how many goals your team scored. 0 goals gets "Unlucky!", 1 or 2 gets "Nice game!", and 3 or more makes you a hat-trick hero.
hint: Python checks if, then each elif in turn, and only runs else if nothing matched.

blocks.code: goals = int(input("How many goals did your team score? "))

expectedOutput: How many goals did your team score? 3
